description: Ministry of Health - The Food (Colour Coding for Sugar levels - Liquid) Regulations
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980, establishing mandatory labeling requirements for sugar content in liquid foods. It creates new regulatory requirements for food labeling, specifies compliance standards, and rescinds previous regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it establishes statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
